position: Private local API, not production service
headline: The source stub can now answer through HTTP.
copy: This gives the team a demoable backend boundary without changing the static site or pretending a real corpus service exists.

postures.title: GET /health
postures.copy: Returns service, version, fixture count, and launch/storage posture.

postures.title: GET /source
postures.copy: Accepts q or question and returns the source packet.

postures.title: POST /source
postures.copy: Accepts JSON with a question for future UI adapters.

postures.title: GET /fixtures
postures.copy: Shows local fixture questions and records for demo visibility.

flow.title: Stop
flow.copy: Close the process after the private demo.

decisions.label: Runtime
decisions.reason: No framework dependency is needed for the first spike.

decisions.label: Data
decisions.reason: The source packet contract stays stable.

decisions.label: CORS
decisions.reason: Allowed for browser adapter testing, not production policy.

decisions.label: Persistence
decisions.reason: No file or account writes are performed.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled by this release.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed source text delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: The local server is a demo harness, not a hosted API or production trust boundary.

packet:
Local Source API Server v4.7.2
Run: node scripts/vedapath-local-source-api-server.mjs --port 8787
Endpoints: /health, /fixtures, /source?q=..., POST /source.
Boundary: no storage, no live AI, no public launch.
